subject: Post-call: inference budget scenarios & pilot pathway
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Lee <jessica@latticepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T15:22:00-04:00
Subject: Post-call: inference budget scenarios & pilot pathway

Jessica — thanks for your time today. Quick recap from our 30-min call and proposed next steps so we have alignment.

Key pain points you raised:
- Per-transaction token spend spikes on peak hours (checkout flows) are eating into margins; you currently cap model calls to keep costs predictable.
- Latency sensitivity for live checkout (goal: P95 < 200ms).
- Procurement needs a clear ROI and a concise TCO for exec sign-off; procurement timeline ~3-4 weeks after SOW.

Goals we heard:
- Reduce net per-transaction inference cost by at least 40% in the pilot (via batching + KV/prefix caching + lower-cost model variants).
- Maintain or improve latency targets for production traffic.
- Produce a short TCO showing run-rate impact and a path to commit to a 3-month pilot.

What we propose (pilot scope):
1) 2-week calibration with sample traffic + A/B telemetry (latency/cost/quality)
2) Apply batching (request-level grouping) and automatic prefix/KV caching for common checkout prompts
3) Run a quantized model variant for cost comparison (we'll show BLEU/quality metrics on your prompt set)
4) Ops playbook: rollback and fallback routes to ensure availability during model experimentation

Initial economics we'll deliver:
- Short spreadsheet with three run-rate scenarios (conservative / expected / aggressive) showing token/unit costs, throughput assumptions, and expected monthly spend deltas.
- High-level ROI slide: estimated savings vs. projected incremental conversions from improved latency.

Immediate next steps
- I will share the TCO spreadsheet and a 1-page pilot scope by tomorrow EOD (attached: Inference-TCO-scenarios.xlsx).
- Can you confirm procurement contact and the target budget approval date? You mentioned an internal review the week of Sep 20 — is that still correct?
- If procurement needs SOC2 docs / SSO info, we'll include our compliance packet in the next email.

Attachments: Inference-TCO-scenarios.xlsx (spreadsheet with scenarios)

Thanks — looking forward to keeping the momentum.

—
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | (415) 555-0134

From: Jessica Lee <jessica@latticepay.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@latticepay.com
Date: 2026-09-08T17:01:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: inference budget scenarios & pilot pathway

Thanks, Aditya — nice write-up and aligned on the ask. Couple clarifications from our side: 

1) Budget: finance has earmarked up to $60k for a pilot phase (cap), but they need a clear worst-case monthly run rate and a plan to cap spend. If the aggressive scenario shows >$20k/mo, we'll need a contractual cap or automatic throttles.
2) Procurement timeline: we aim to have procurement sign-off by Sep 24 if the SOW and TCO are straightforward.
3) Compliance: please include SOC 2 Type II attestation and detail around data retention (we are regulated in CA/NY).

I've attached our RFP requirements PDF so you can see what procurement will verify on the SOW. Also, please include an explicit line item for "automatic spending caps" in the TCO.

Att: Lattice_RFP_requirements.pdf

Question for you: can Redwood support scoped customer-managed keys (KMS) for the pilot? We may need that for the production rollout.

Best,
Jessica
Head of Product | LatticePay
jessica@latticepay.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: inference budget scenarios & pilot pathway

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Jessica's procurement asks. Action items:
- Ben: can you update the TCO sheet to include a capped worst-case scenario with an explicit "spend cap" contract line and an auto-throttle option? Also run a sensitivity for peak-hour QPS that shows monthly spend at +25% and +50% traffic.
- Marissa: please prep a one-page compliance packet (SOC2 Type II, data retention summary, KMS options summary) we can send to procurement. They specifically called out customer-managed KMS.

Timeline: need updated spreadsheet + packet by EOD Sep 9 PST so we can send to procurement and hit their Sep 24 target.

—Aditya

Full on-prem KMS would be in the Private deployment SOW; I called that out in the attached packet.

2) Attached is the updated TCO spreadsheet with three scenarios and an explicit "Contractual cap" row. I also added the auto-throttle option and a "peak sensitivity" tab.

Summary of what we sent: 
- Inference-TCO-scenarios.xlsx (conservative / expected / aggressive scenarios; contractual cap line)
- Compliance packet (SOC2 summary, data retention, KMS options) — shared via Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1tco_sheet

Next steps (locked):
- You review the spreadsheet + packet with procurement (procurement@latticepay.com).
- If OK, we draft a short statement of work for a 3-month pilot with a $60k cap and automatic throttles tied to spend thresholds.
- Proposed pilot start window: Oct 4 (calibration week) — will confirm once we have procurement sign-off.

If procurement needs any additional artifacts I can loop engineering (Ben) on a live session.

Attachments: Inference-TCO-scenarios.xlsx
